subject: English
question_text: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives: 1 ✕ 7 =
stimulus: i. What should you not do when you see a blackbird? (a) Chase it (b) Throw stones at it (c) Feed it (d) Shoot it ii. What is one of the things the text advises you to make? (a) Stew (b) Bread pudding (c) Soup (d) Cake iii. According to the text, what should you do if you catch a fish you don't like? (a) Eat it (b) Throw it back (c) Give it away (d) Cook it iv. What advice is given for dealing with a man who bullies you? (a) Leave him immediately (b) Bullies him back (c) Understand how to handle him (d) Ignore him v. What does the text suggest to do when you feel like spitting up in the air? (a) Let it fall (b) Move quickly (c) Close your mouth (d) Wait for it to dry vi. What does the text say you should do to ensure bread is fresh? (a) Smell it (b) Look at it (c) Squeeze it (d) Wait a day vii. What is the mother's reaction to her daughter’s reluctance to touch the bread? (a) She encourages her to touch it (b) She gets angry (c) She wonders if her daughter will become the kind of woman who can't approach bread (d) She ignores it
